thread:
lena (pm): CatalystHealth asked us to commit to private deploy + customer KMS + Dedicated capacity by Jun 30. Need alignment on scope and launch criteria. TL;DR: we can do an MVP by Jun if we relax the HSM requirement and postpone the full KMS audit; full HSM path by Aug. Thoughts?

omar (eng): We can cut an MVP by Jun but need PRs for multi-key routing and the runtime change for private key wrapping (PR#412). Also need the quantized model bundle for private. Major blockers: KV-cache stability under long prefixes, and infra reservation for Dedicated. ETA for engineering work: ~2 weeks for PRs if nothing else blocks.

tess (se): @lena can you confirm Catalyst will accept "customer-managed KMS later" in the SOW? Their security lead was pretty firm about HSM at first glance.

raj (acct): Catalyst said timeline flexibility but legal wants milestone-driven SOW with acceptance criteria. We should propose explicit fallbacks and rollback/runbook items.

anya (security): We can't ship HSM deferred without explicit customer sign-off. Minimum acceptable for MVP: at-rest key wrapping using customer KMS (no HSM) + documented residual risk and signed acceptance. We'll need a short risk doc and an acceptance form from Catalyst.

marc (sales): Staged commit sounds fine: MVP = private deploy + wrapped keys + Dedicated quota; then HSM + SIEM connector later. Recommend we include an SLA delta for MVP (lower uptime guarantee until HSM/connector are in). That helps legal/finance sign-off.

olivia (legal): I can draft a milestone-based amendment and an acceptance checklist. Need precise acceptance criteria for each milestone (what counts as "MVP accepted").

ci-bot: Build #412 ran: integration tests failed on kvcache timeout. See logs: ```TimeoutError: KV cache miss > 5s at runtime/kvcache.go:214```

omar (eng): Acknowledged. That KV cache timeout is flaky when long prefix caching interacts with the continuous batching path. I'll put a patch up today to surface better metrics and increase the timeout for the test. ETA 24h.

tess (se): We also need per-route observability filters in Console for their compliance team to scrub PHI from traces. Is that something we can ship as a toggle in the private Console for MVP?

lena (pm): We can include a "console filter" config toggle for private deploys in MVP — low-risk feature flag. We'll document limitations in the SOW.

anya (security): Audit logs must be tamper-evident. For MVP we can provide S3 immutability + checksum and a signed manifest. Full SIEM connector with real-time forwarding can be staged for Aug. Need the risk acceptance before go-live.

raj (acct): Catalyst wants a go/no-go decision by May 15 for procurement planning. Is that reasonable?

omar (eng): If PRs merge in 2 weeks, KV-cache fixes land, and infra can reserve capacity, May 15 go/no-go is doable. Need infra confirmation on quota reservation.

frank (eng-infra): Infra can hold a Dedicated reservation for 30 days with an LOI from sales. We'll need expected GPU type (they asked for 4x A100-equivalent) and region. Send me the LOI and a short capacity ticket.

marc (sales): I'll draft the LOI today and attach preliminary capacity numbers.

lena (pm): Proposed milestone timeline:
1) LOI & SOW with milestone acceptance criteria — target May 5
2) PR merges, KV-cache fix, infra reservation — target May 20
3) MVP private deploy (wrapped KMS, console filter, S3 immutability logs) — target Jun 30
4) HSM enable + SIEM connector + final audit — target Aug 15
Please react with :thumbsup: if you agree or propose changes.

tess (se): :+1: from SE side, we can run onboarding playbooks.

anya (security): :+1: with a caveat — need the risk doc by May 12 and the signed acceptance before any prod keys are rotated.

olivia (legal): I'll circulate the SOW draft and milestone wording by EOD.

raj (acct): Their security lead also asked for monthly compliance calls post-launch. Can we commit to weekly during onboarding, then monthly ongoing?

lena (pm): Yes — propose weekly for first 6 weeks, then monthly. I'll set a recurring invite after LOI.

marc (sales): :rocket: Let's move this forward.

lena (pm): OK — action items: Marc send LOI today; Olivia drafts SOW; Omar lands KV-cache patch; Frank holds reservation on LOI; Anya prepares short risk doc. I'll assemble a one-pager for Catalyst execs. I'll ping everyone in 48h for status.
